Subaru Socialism, then, is the understandable inability to imagine a middle class life by college educated people who are technically middle class but don’t feel any stability or hope for upward mobility. 

This discontent has been paired with and charged by anger over Gaza.

The synthesis of these two blocs and their main complaints: hopelessness of entering the middle class and the hard line moral stance on Gaza have joined w boomer anger over the establishment losing to Trump 2x. That’s the energy behind all these upstart campaigns and the future.

I also think that fine tune message stuff probably doesn’t matter as much as everyone wants to think on here. This site was structured to react to small bits of text and now video clips and so basically the entire game is to say this clip is why a candidate wins or loses.

The problem is that there’s like 500 clips and you can’t really remember any of them tbh they just accumulate in a good or bad vibe. That’s why I don’t really think any one thing is fatal or wins someone the election. Every big candidate goes viral every day now.
